coincidentAcquisition.detail: No recovered Sentinel-1 product covering the detection point was acquired at the detection time. The nearest covering acquisition is 11.47 h away. CleanSeaNet's own source scene for this detection was not recovered, so no swath is drawn at the detection time.

notes: Footprints and acquisition windows only. No orbital path or ground track is synthesised: the export contains nothing about the satellite between acquisitions.
These are catalogue records. No SAR pixels are held locally for any of them (pixelsAvailable is false on every record).
Swath geometry is kept separate from oil geometry throughout.

provenance.selection: Products containing the detection point or within 0.75 degrees of it.
